summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of GYROBALANCE app on public URL. Verified landing page (10 sections) and /simulator route on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (375x800). All critical flows (Hero CTAs, How It Works, 3D Visualization slider/heatmap/auto-correct, Architecture nodes, AI Analysis run-to-result, Features, Why It Matters, Final CTA, Simulator physics, Apply AI Counterweight, Reset, Back, Mobile menu) work without runtime errors. The node_modules patch for @react-three/fiber successfully suppresses the 'x-line-number' R3F error from the visual-edits Babel plugin — no R3F errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Patching files inside node_modules/@react-three/fiber/dist/ is a fragile workaround — it will be lost on every fresh `yarn install` or CI build. Recommend either (a) wrapping R3F components and stripping x-* / data-* JSX props at the application boundary, (b) configuring the @emergentbase/visual-edits Babel plugin to skip files under react-three/* and components rendered inside <Canvas>, or (c) adding a postinstall script that re-applies the patch (e.g., via patch-package) so the fix survives reinstalls.

Simulator suggestion text (data-testid='sim-suggestion') did not update after Apply AI Counterweight (still showed pre-AI value '400.0 g @ 5 cm'). CG correctly moves to 22.50 cm but the suggestion string appears stale. Verify whether the suggestion should be cleared/updated post-AI application.
Some testids in code (e.g., on AIAnalysis) carry visual-edits attributes (x-line-number, x-file-name, x-id) into rendered DOM — harmless but increases DOM payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully client-side, no backend APIs. To trigger React-controlled <input type=range> updates, use Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set then dispatch input+change events (raw el.value=... does NOT trigger React onChange). AI Analysis takes ~30s+ to complete (60 readings); use wait_for_function with 45s timeout. Apply AI Counterweight in /simulator drives CG to 22.50 cm target. Mobile navbar toggle data-testid='navbar-mobile-toggle' opens overlay menu. The R3F node_modules patch must NOT be reverted.
verified_flows: Hero testids: hero-3d-container, hero-title ('AI-Powered Wind Turbine Blade Balancing'), hero-cta-explore, hero-cta-simulator
Visualization: viz-cg-slider 0.8 -> deviation +13.50cm/cw 10.5g; 0.2 -> deviation -13.50cm; viz-correct-cg sets slider to 0.5; viz-toggle-heatmap clickable
Architecture: all 6 nodes (loadcells, esp32, wifi, rpi, dash, report) present
AI Analysis: ai-run-button -> ai-progress-bar -> ai-result with MEASURED CG/DEVIATION/COUNTERWEIGHT values
Simulator: sim-w1, sim-w2 update sim-cg; sim-vmass-plus/minus adjust vmass; sim-apply-ai moves CG to 22.50cm; simulator-reset restores; simulator-back returns to /
Mobile (375x800): navbar-mobile-toggle opens menu; hero/architecture sections visible
